units.title: EDUCATIONAL PSYCHOLOGY AND DEVELOPMENT
units.topics: 1.1 Meaning, nature, scope and limitations of educational psychology. 1.2 Methods of educational psychology : a) Introspection b) Observation c) Experimental. (Nature, merits and limitations of each method) 1.3 Concept of growth and development 1.4 Stages of development: physical, intellectual, emotional, and social development i)Infancy ii) Later childhood iii) Adolescence Their salient features and educational significance

units.title: PERSONALITY AND INDIVIDUAL DIFFERENCES
units.topics: 2.1 Concept meaning and nature of personality. 2.2 Factors affecting on personality development. 2.3 Characteristics of integrated personality. 2.4 Role of school in development of personality. 2.5 Individual difference - concept and definitions, Causes of individual differences 2.6 Educational implication of individual differences

units.title: SECONDARY EDUCATION
units.topics: 1.1 Secondary Education – meaning and importance 1.2 Aims of Secondary Education – Mudliyar Commission, National Education policy 1.3 Secondary Education – Problems and remedial measures to overcome these problems

units.title: SCHOOL AND EDUCATION
units.topics: 2.1 School as a social Institution 2.2 Role and function of school in developing: 2.2.1 Character of students 2.2.2 National Integration 2.2.3 Democratic citizenship

units.title: INCLUSIVE EDUCATION
units.topics: 1.1 Meaning and concept of Inclusive Education. 1.2 Need and importance of Inclusive Education. 1.3 Benefits of Inclusion. 1.4 Education for special educational needs students. 1.5 Inclusive Education policies in India. Course Related Practical Work – Visit any special school and write a report. or Prepare the report on inclusive education policies in India.

units.title: GUIDANCE
units.topics: 1.1 Meaning, definitions and Nature of Guidance. 1.2 Need and Scope of Guidance. 1.3 Objectives of Guidance. 1.4 Types of Guidance - Educational, Vocational, Personal.

units.title: COUNSELING
units.topics: 2.1 Meaning, definition and nature of Counseling. 2.2 Need and Scope of Counseling. 2.3 Objectives of Counseling. 2.4 Difference between Guidance and Counseling. 2.5 Role and qualities of Counselor.

units.title: HIGHER EDUCATION
units.topics: 1.1 Higher Education – Meaning and Importance. 1.2 Aims of Higher Education – Radhakrishnan Commission, NEP 2020 1.3 Higher Education – Problems and remedial measures to overcome these problems. 1.4 RUSA – meaning, objectives and functions.

units.title: TEACHER AND EDUCATION
units.topics: 2.1 Importance of Teacher in the 21st century 2.2 Qualifications and qualities of an ideal teacher. 2.3 Challenges before teacher in the 21st century. 2.4 Code of conduct of teacher.

units.title: CURRICULUM CONSTRUCTION
units.topics: 1. Meaning and definitions of Curriculum. 2. Importance of Curriculum. 3. Principles of Curriculum Construction. 4. Stages of Curriculum Construction. 5. Process of Curriculum Development. Course Related Practical Work – Critical evaluation of any one subject syllabus of secondary school (Std 9 or 10). or Construction of a unit test on any one subject of secondary school.

units.title: Tools and techniques of Guidance and Counseling.
units.topics: 1. Approaches of counseling - Directive counseling, non-directive counselling, Eclectic counselling 2. Tools and techniques of Guidance and Counselling- Case study, Rating scale, Sociometry, Interview, Anecdotal Record, Questionnaire. 3. Group Guidance and Group counseling: a) Group Guidance – meaning, Definitions, objectives, Techniques, use. b) Group Counseling – meaning, concept, stages, techniques and benefits Course Related Practical Work: Visit to a guidance / counselling center and write a report. or Preparation of a tool for identifying the educational needs of Students.

units.title: MASS COMMUNICATION MEDIA
units.topics: 1. Concept of Mass Communication Media 2. Nature and Importance of Mass Media. 3. Types of Mass Media - a) Press b) Radio c) Internet d) Television 4. Role of Mass Media in Education 5. Social Networking: types and nature Course Related Practical Work: Prepare a report on the impact of social media on children’s. or Prepare a report on the role of mass media in educational and social development.
